Q3.answer: Not confined to one registered precision across the envelope, but gains are visibly dependent on the fixed synthesizer angle/precision sequences
Q3.evidence: Controlled rho half-angle T=36 vs ordinary x T=42 at x=1/4,1e-3; rho T=46 vs ordinary x T=52 at x=1/8,1e-4. Both rho keys are not universally cheaper at tighter registered precisions.
